name: bottom
description: Cross-platform system monitor with customizable TUI and themes

btm.description: Interactive system monitor with CPU, memory, network, and disk widgets
btm.usage:
btm # Launch full interactive monitor
btm -b # Basic mode without graphs and expanded details
btm -S # Sort processes by memory usage
btm --color=gruvbox # Apply gruvbox color theme
btm -r 2000 # Refresh every 2 seconds instead of default 1s
